auth.registered: Account created. You can now sign in.
auth.rejected: The request could not be accepted. Check your details or try again later.
auth.recoveryWarning: Security questions are a weak recovery method. Forgotten answers or disabled recovery can mean permanent account loss. Do not rely on this development build for safety.
auth.passwordPolicy: Use 12–128 characters with letters and at least one other character. Avoid common passwords and your username.
auth.loadFailed: Could not load sessions. Sign in again if your session expired.
auth.passwordChangeNotice: Your current password is required. Changing it signs out every session, including this one. Sign in again with your new password.
auth.retryAfter: Too many attempts. Try again after at least {seconds} seconds.
auth.localeSaveFailed: Language preference could not be saved. Your previous choice is unchanged.

privacy.title: Development privacy notice
privacy.development: This is a development build, not a released safety service. Do not enter sensitive personal information.
privacy.data: We store your username, password hash, hashed security answers, account state, hashed session secrets and security audit events. We do not collect an email address or mobile number. No telemetry is sent.
privacy.retention: Account deactivation preserves records; there is no account-deletion feature. Audit and operational records remain retained. Candidate retention windows below are not enforced schedules. A deployment-specific retention, export and deletion policy must be approved before public use.
privacy.sessions: Configured lifetimes in seconds: access token {access}; refresh family {refresh}; login-attempt window {login}. Refresh rotation does not extend the family expiry. You can revoke sessions in security settings.
privacy.unavailable: Current configuration could not be loaded. Do not rely on previously published default windows; try again or contact the deployment operator.
privacy.requestedOn: The automated-deletion switch is enabled. Only the implemented scope below is active; it does not enable account, audit or operational-record deletion.
privacy.requestedOff: The automated-deletion switch is disabled. No automated retention pass deletes records.
privacy.cleanupOn: Expired computational challenges may be removed in bounded batches after a grace of {grace} seconds. This is the only implemented deletion scope.
privacy.cleanupOff: Computational challenge cleanup is inactive. Expired challenges remain unusable even when retained.
privacy.candidates: Candidate retention values in days: audit {audit}; operational records {operational}. Zero means no scheduled deletion. Neither value currently causes audit or operational-record deletion.
privacy.recoveryWindows: Configured recovery lifetimes in seconds: question challenge {challenge}; verified grant {grant}. Expiry prevents reuse; expiry alone does not erase records.
privacy.unapproved: This development policy is not a deployment approval or a production privacy guarantee. Automated export, account deletion and general retention enforcement are not implemented.
privacy.streamWindows: Security-stream tickets expire within {ticket} seconds and are single-use. Each connection ends within {stream} seconds or at access expiry, whichever comes first. Expired/consumed ticket records are retained; no automatic ticket deletion is enabled.

report.title: Report a security concern
report.body: Report suspected account compromise, abuse or a vulnerability to this deployment’s operator inbox without an account. If you can still sign in, revoke other sessions as well. Reports do not reset passwords or prove account ownership.
report.privateLink: Open private security reporting on GitHub
report.warning: Use synthetic examples and the minimum detail needed. Never submit passwords, security answers, tokens, private locations or other people’s personal data. Do not publish vulnerability details in a public issue.
report.expectation: Reports are stored privately for manual operator review. No email or phone contact is collected, and there is no reply or tracking channel. No response time, account recovery or emergency assistance is guaranteed. Repository vulnerabilities can alternatively use GitHub private reporting, which requires a GitHub account.
report.accepted: Your report was stored in the operator inbox. This does not confirm a compromise or any action. If submission was uncertain, avoid repeatedly sending the same report.
report.invalid: Choose a concern type and enter 20–4,000 characters without unsupported control characters.
report.limited: Too many reports. Please wait before trying again; do not send repeated copies.
report.failed: Receipt could not be confirmed. The report may already have been stored; avoid repeated copies. Try later if necessary.

recovery.title: Recover password
recovery.disabled: Self-service recovery is unavailable. A forgotten password may mean permanent account loss; only administrator-assisted recovery may remain.
recovery.done: Password reset. All previous sessions have been signed out. Sign in again.
recovery.failed: Recovery could not be completed. Check your answers or start again. No individual answer result is shown.

securityNotices.password_reset: Your password was reset through recovery. If this was not you, change your password and report the concern.
securityNotices.password_changed: Your password was changed. All older sessions were revoked.
securityNotices.security_answers_changed: Your security questions were changed. All previous sessions were revoked.

securityAnswers.title: Change security questions
securityAnswers.notice: Confirm your current password and choose five distinct questions. This replaces every answer, cancels recovery attempts and signs out all sessions.

setup.title: First sign-in with a temporary credential
setup.notice: Use the temporary credential from your administrator. It expires after 24 hours and works once. Complete password and question setup within ten minutes; if interrupted beyond that limit, ask your administrator for help. Normal features remain unavailable until both steps are complete.
setup.done: Setup complete. Sign in with your new password.

adminCreate.title: Create an account
adminCreate.notice: Confirm your current password. Leave the temporary password blank to generate a one-time credential. Accounts receive only the user role and must complete first-login setup.
adminCreate.created: Account created. Deliver the credential privately; it cannot be retrieved later. Use the first sign-in page.

adminManage.title: Account lifecycle and permissions
adminManage.notice: Every change requires your current password. Do not put credentials or private information in reasons. Removing the last full administrator is refused.
adminManage.replaceWarning: This replaces all role assignments. Select the complete new set; an empty set removes every role.
adminManage.reissueWarning: Only active accounts awaiting initial setup are eligible. This invalidates prior setup proofs and restarts both setup steps; it cannot reset a completed account.

adminSearch.utc: Enter UTC instants such as 2026-10-17T12:00:00Z. The start is inclusive; the end is exclusive.

challenge.title: Privacy-first security challenge
challenge.notice: Check before submitting. If required, this device computes a short proof of work without puzzles, third-party requests or tracking. This is not proof of human identity and does not replace rate limits.
challenge.working: Computing a proof of work. You can cancel without submitting your credentials.
challenge.ready: Check complete. Submit the form now; a proof expires quickly and is single-use.
challenge.idle: Check whether a challenge is required, then submit the form.
challenge.failed: The check could not finish or has expired. Try again. Unsupported devices cannot bypass the check; contact an administrator for assistance.

securityStream.label: Account security notices
securityStream.unavailable: Live security notices are connecting or unavailable. Previously stored notices remain available in account settings after sign-in. A notice is informational; use the normal sign-in and session controls.
